_comment: Plausible questions the KB does not answer (T-01). They are the seeds of the hallucination-inducing adversarial scenarios of T-06: the correct behaviour is to say the question is not covered and escalate (F03, F04), never to invent a deadline or a policy.

unanswerable.question: Can I choose a delivery time slot, like an afternoon delivery?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB gives delivery estimates in business days and says nothing about scheduling a time
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that scheduling a delivery window is not covered and escalate; invent no time slot

unanswerable.question: Can I collect the order at one of your stores instead of having it delivered?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB describes an online-only operation and never mentions physical stores or pick-up points
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that pick-up is not covered and escalate; do not claim stores exist or do not exist

unanswerable.question: My sister gave me this as a present. Can I return it with the gift receipt, in my name?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB has no gift-receipt or third-party return policy; it only speaks of the customer who placed the order
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that returns by someone other than the buyer are not covered and escalate

unanswerable.question: The sole came off after two months of use. What is the warranty for a manufacturing defect?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB covers the 30-day return window and items damaged on arrival, not a manufacturing warranty after use
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that the warranty for defects found after the return window is not covered and escalate; invent no warranty period

unanswerable.question: If I cancel, do I lose the points I earned on this purchase?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB describes no loyalty or points programme
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that a points programme is not covered and escalate

unanswerable.question: Can you cancel the order and put the money into an account credit instead of my card?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: F28 refunds a cancellation to the original payment method; the KB never allows converting a cancellation refund into store credit
unanswerable.expected_behavior: state the F28 rule and escalate the request for a different form of refund; do not agree to convert it

unanswerable.question: Instead of reissuing the slip, can you switch my order to a card payment?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB covers reissuing a slip and placing a new order, never changing the payment method of an existing one
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that changing the payment method of an existing order is not covered and escalate

unanswerable.question: How many instalments can I split this into?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB says nothing about instalments
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that instalment options are not covered and escalate; invent no number of instalments

unanswerable.question: Do you have a membership that gives free shipping on every order?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB prices express delivery and return labels but describes no membership or subscription
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that a membership is not covered and escalate

unanswerable.question: How long do you keep my personal data after I delete my account?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: the KB contains no data-retention or privacy policy
unanswerable.expected_behavior: say that data retention is not covered and escalate to a human specialist; invent no retention period
